_about: Post-processing settings of the Scapes style: the one place for their numbers. They are the settings object of core/image/adjust.js (brightness: levels 0..255 added to luma; saturation: multiplier of the colour difference from luma; sharpen: unsharp mask on luma, amount and Gaussian radius in px). neutral = no change. start = the starting settings per generation model (OpenRouter model id), chosen on the trial cards: the measures they give and why are in RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки» and COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации». sharpen_amount_max = the upper bound of sharpening on the trial cards (RENDERING.md, same section). Re-check on new generations with checks/adjust-trial.mjs.
